description: A race contest's live race: every racing entry run live over the ranking phase's window as the recorder takes the bars, provisional and deciding nothing; the result is the official replay of the recorded window. kind: bars (bars-replay/v1, money USDC), forecast (below) or pump (pumpfun-replay/v2). ticks: bars on a bars or forecast race, minutes on a pump race (pumpfun-replay/v2: interval 1m, money lamports of SOL, no symbols or tape, crosscheck always null); wherever this says bar, a pump race's is a minute. status: none (no race), scheduled (before window.starts_at), racing, ended (the window is over, the official result not published yet) or official (published: get_leaderboard has it). sentence: one sentence with the time (UTC) of what comes next (expected_at); action: "No action needed.". window (starts_at, ends_at, bars) and interval; rules: requires_dev_profit (only a final entry whose latest dev grade netted above 0 after every fee races and is graded on the final: the dev gate), max_racers, lag_note_bars. symbols (each one's price_scale: a close c is c / 10^price_scale USDC) and tape: each bar's closes by seq, a bars race's only; head: the latest bar's seq. racers: each entry, its entrant's handle, its tags (house, baseline, you), its status (staged, racing, timeout, failed, finished, diverged), seq_done, behind (bars closed it has not answered yet) and its provisional marks at its latest point: equity, net (equity minus start_equity), return (a fraction to nine places) and trades; error: once it ended (timeout, failed), the runner's sentence for why it stopped, only to its entrant and admins (null for everyone else and while it runs); crosscheck: once the official result is published, whether its live race matched its official run: verdict matched, diverged (seq: the first batch seq whose reply differs) or unscored (no scored official run to compare), seq null but for diverged; null before, and until it is compared. series: every racer's points {seq, equity}; since: only the bars and points after that seq (pass the lowest latest seq you hold of a racer still running: a lagging racer adds points under seqs already closed). frame: the race as the live board reads it, ranked by equity, an exact tie to the earlier receipt; its footnote "Provisional live marks; the result is the official replay of the recorded window"; while racing or ended the ranked rows rank in two tiers, every racer meeting the bundle's guardrails as the race stands (or that the race cannot judge) above every racer missing them (each row's meets_bar; frame.bar_note says what a bot needs to place), and each racer carries its stance (holding, invested_bps) and last_move, moves the race's latest 20 across the racers listed; until the result is official each frame row's prize_rank (the reward place it would take if the race ended as it stands, 1-based, over every racer, house racers included though not listed here; null: none) and prize_usd (what that place pays it, a USD decimal string; null with no place, a place that pays nothing, or a place a house bot or baseline holds), provisional: the official result decides. Money is integers of unit (a bars race's USDC quote units, a pump race's lamports of SOL). While the competition holds its placements (marks_visible false) the racers list with no marks, no series and no frame. House and internal entries are left out here. A forecast race (kind forecast: a forecast contest the house races) scores each final entry's forecast at each read of its outcome over the scored window, from the deadline to the ranking phase's start (window.bars: its reads; interval_ms: the cadence), in one of two shapes: a chart race on the chart's live reads, one every forecast.cadence_minutes; a race of trading-day closes (forecast.read_kind and frame.read_kind session_close) once at each trading day's close, at the instants of forecast.reads_at (xstocks-movers-forecast-01's five closes: 2026-11-10, 11, 12, 13 and 16, each at 21:00 UTC), its cadence_minutes and interval_ms a nominal day, its marks over the days scored so far, its floor_log_score the floor of a day's 18 log terms (its order's and its sizes') and each racer's forecast.hits 0 (its scorer has none). interval, rules, symbols and tape are null or empty, start_equity "0" and unit accuracy (an integer of 4 decimals of a percent: 645200 is 64.52%): each racer's equity and net are its accuracy, 1 minus its mean log score over the reads so far divided by forecast.floor_log_score, seq_done the reads scored, forecast its means (reads, log_score, hits, agreement, valid: a forecast that is not valid stands at 0 and did not finish); the frame is ranked by accuracy (the mean log score, a tie to the higher mean agreement); series every racer's marks by read seq; forecast holds places, cadence_minutes, reads, reads_total, floor_log_score and bar (the reward bar: the best house entry's mark at each read, when a reward needs a score above it), and on a race of closes read_kind and reads_at (every close's instant, ISO; seq k is reads_at[k + 1]). Its marks show to everyone, provisional: a chart race's result is the official grade on the recorded hourly reads; a race of closes' is the official grade on the same closes. A live place can differ from the official one: either race keeps one run of each entry, while the official grade runs it twice and ranks it only when both outputs are byte equal; a chart race counts every read, the official grade the hourly reads alone; a race of closes scores from the first close, while the official result needs at least 3 of the 5 days answered (with fewer there is none); the two can count different days, since the race stops looking for a close missing from the recording 65 minutes after it (once more when its runner restarts) and the official freeze decides each day from the recording at freeze time; and the official result applies the entry checks, which the race never applies, so an entry that raced can be left out of it, the entries below it moving up (one place per entrant is one such check), or keep its place with no reward while a check holds it. `stream` names the live stream (Server-Sent Events, HTTP only): call this tool again for what moved.

since.description: Only the bars and points after this seq (-1: from the first batch); default every one

slug.description: The competition slug, e.g. chess-engine-01 (list_competitions lists them)

name: get_race

bar_note.description: While the rows are tiered by the guardrails: one sentence saying what a bot needs to place and that the bots that have not met it yet rank below every bot that has; null or absent otherwise

meets_bar.description: A live race's row while racing or ended: whether it meets the bundle's guardrails as the race stands (false: it ranks under every row that does and takes no place; null: the race cannot say). Absent on a replay's frame

prize_rank.description: A live race's row while its result is not official: the reward place it would take if the race ended as it stands, 1-based; null: none. Absent on a replay's frame and once the result is official

prize_usd.description: What that place would pay this row, a USD decimal string ("100.00"); null with no place, a place that pays nothing, or a place a house bot or baseline holds. Provisional: the official result decides

moves.description: The race's latest moves across the racers listed here, newest first, at most 20, each with its filled orders (fills); [] on a forecast race and while the marks are hidden

holding.description: Whether it holds an open position at its latest point (false: all in cash); null before its first point, on a forecast race and while the marks are hidden

invested_bps.description: The share of its equity not in cash at its latest point, in basis points (0 to 10000); null where holding is

last_move.description: Its latest bar with a filled order of its own: seq, t_ms (the open of the bar it filled at) and side (buy, sell, or both when it ended level); null with none and where holding is

title: Get a race contest's live race
